### TD SYNNEX Wins Global and Regional Distributor of the Year Honors at Cisco Partner Summit 2026


October 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/109490932/files/doc_news/TD-SYNNEX-Wins-Global-and-Regional-Distributor-of-the-Year-Honors-at-Cisco-Partner-Summit-2026-2026.pdf)


FREMONT, Calif. & CLEARWATER, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


TD SYNNEX (NYSE:SNX) has been named Global Distributor of the Year and Americas Distributor of the Year for the second consecutive year at Cisco Partner Summit 2026. TD SYNNEX was also recognized as EMEA Distributor of the Year by Cisco.


Cisco Partner Awards recognize top-performing partners demonstrating service excellence and innovation in delivering solutions that help our customers succeed. Awarded to partners for standout success and exemplary sales and service, Partner Summit Global Awards are the highest form of recognition for Cisco partners.


Over the past year, TD SYNNEX continued to invest in its Cisco practice through a new design-to-delivery operating model in North America that leverages digital and AI capabilities to simplify engagement and maximize the value of Cisco specialists. The company also expanded access to immersive security training and live Cisco solution demonstrations through its Cyber Range, while accelerating growth across key Cisco architecture segments and outpacing both local and global market growth.


“To be recognized by Cisco as their Distributor of the Year globally and in the Americas for a second consecutive year is a tremendous honor,” said Reyna Thompson, President, North America, at TD SYNNEX. “It reflects the trust, collaboration and shared vision that define our relationship with Cisco. By combining their innovative technology with TD SYNNEX’s reach, specialized expertise and enablement capabilities, we are helping partners confidently navigate transformation, drive business outcomes and fuel long-term growth.”


"This recognition reflects the strength of our partnership with Cisco and the dedication of our teams across the region," said Miriam Murphy, President, EMEA, at TD SYNNEX. “Together, we are helping partners unlock new opportunities through innovation, specialization and enablement that drive meaningful business outcomes and sustainable growth.”


"It’s my pleasure to recognize TD SYNNEX as the 2026 Global Distributor of the Year," said Tim Coogan, SVP, Global Partner Sales, Cisco. “Through their commitment to partnership and their ability to deliver customer outcomes that matter, TD SYNNEX is proof that when we invest in each other’s success and stay focused on our shared goals, everybody wins."


Cisco Partner Summit Geo awards reflect the top-performing partners within specific technology markets across a geographical region. Award recipients are selected by a committee of executives representing Cisco’s Global and Regional Partner Sales Organizations.


To learn more about TD SYNNEX and Cisco, visit[https://www.tdsynnex.com/na/us/cisco/sso/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tdsynnex.com%2Fna%2Fus%2Fcisco%2Fsso%2F&esheet=54630042&newsitemid=20261028474830&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tdsynnex.com%2Fna%2Fus%2Fcisco%2Fsso%2F&index=1&md5=6bb3eeb990879552f89e80e27ca689d5) .


**About TD SYNNEX**


TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) **** is a leading global distributor, solutions aggregator, and original design and contract manufacturer that plays a central role in connecting the technology ecosystem. We support more than 150,000 customers across over 100 countries with a comprehensive edge-to-cloud portfolio spanning cybersecurity, analytics, artificial intelligence, mobility, and Everything-as-a-Service. We are a Fortune 100 company that helps partners maximize the value of technology investments and achieve measurable business outcomes through our global reach, expertise and enablement capabilities. Headquartered in Clearwater, Florida, and Fremont, California, the Company's distribution business brings together a broad portfolio of IT hardware, software and systems, providing access to products across the global IT ecosystem. The Company's Hyve Solutions business partners with technology companies to design, manufacture, and deliver traditional and accelerated compute, cloud, and connected infrastructure.
